name: net_init_from_zrd
description: Net::InitFromZrd initializes multiplayer mission state from net.zrd spawn data, creates the local player row, initializes host timer state, and respawns the local player.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent GameNet/zNetwork mission-start source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x431dd0 validates AI save-state deactivation, zTurret disable, net.zrd spawn array parsing, local row creation from zNetwork identity/name/color, non-host color wait and fatal failure path, host color/timer initialization, player-list refresh, local respawn, race-mode long-countdown reset, and pkt06 initial sync state.

The native Net init smoke writes a real net.zrd, runs the host initialization path, and verifies parsed spawn points, local player row identity/color/name, host HUD timer state, local respawn placement, and pkt06 initial sync globals.
